pages.text: One sunny morning, <name> slipped on his favorite blue chappals and went out to play. But as soon as he took a step — “La la laaa!” — the chappals started singing!
<name> stopped and blinked. “Did you just sing?” he whispered. The chappals replied with a cheerful “Tap-tap, ta-da!”
Soon, as he walked through the market, the chappals sang louder — “Cha-cha-cha! La la loo!” Everyone turned and started clapping along.
A fruit seller laughed. “What musical feet you have, <name>!” A vegetable aunty twirled her basket and danced. Even the playful cow near the milk shop began to sway and moo in rhythm — “Mooo-la-la!”

<name> tried to tiptoe quietly, but the chappals hummed a sleepy tune — “Shh-shh-sha-laa!” He burst into giggles. Soon the whole market turned into a funny little concert. Children clapped, people sang, and the cow gave a big happy wiggle!

Finally, as the sun began to set, the chappals gave one last soft note — “Good-night-shoe!” — and fell quiet. <name> laughed and patted them gently. “You two are the best singers ever,” he said. That evening, the market still hummed the tune of the singing chappals, and everyone smiled.
